errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва общо пет богата, обозначени като: EUR_USD, Gold, AUD_USD, 4Eн, и 5PET
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the sectors of the main pie chart. It omits the largest sector (7TH, 41%), the 'Schroder' sector (10%), and the 'Other' sector (6%). Instead, it includes sectors from a secondary, exploded pie chart (4EH and SPET) without context. It also misspells the labels '4EH' as '4Eн' and 'SPET' as '5PET'.
The word 'богата' appears to be a typo or an incorrect word choice, likely intended to be 'сектора' (sectors). This makes the sentence awkward.
The description incorrectly states that AUD_USD is 6%. According to the pie chart label, AUD_USD is 4%. The value 6% corresponds to the 'Other' category, which is not mentioned in this list.

errors.text_span: Външният сектор EUR_USD е визуален и отбелязан с 41.2%, а секторът 7TH е визуално подчертан с 10.4%.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. It incorrectly assigns the value 41.2% to EUR_USD, when the chart shows it is 32%. The 41% value belongs to the '7TH' sector. It also incorrectly assigns the value 10.4% to the '7TH' sector, when this value belongs to the 'Schroder' sector. The labels and values are completely mismatched.

errors.text_span: В диаграмата има легенда, която свързва всеки сектор с неговото име.
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain a legend. All labels are placed directly on or next to the pie slices.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос на диаграмата показва процентните дялове на всеки сектор, докато вертикалната ос показва секторите на портфейла.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly mentions horizontal and vertical axes for a pie chart, which does not have axes. This indicates a fundamental misunderstanding of the chart type.

The description completely fails to mention the key structural element of the figure: that it consists of two pie charts, where the second chart is an exploded view that provides a breakdown of the 'Other' category from the main chart.
